steps.say: Planning a party shouldn't take ten apps. Host Mode keeps it all in one place: plan it, run it, and remember it.
It works for baby showers, weddings, birthdays, reunions, and company events, right from your phone.
Hosting your own event? Start with I'm hosting an event.
Planning for clients? I plan events for clients shows client portals, templates, and team tools.
Got an invite code? Type it here, then tap Create my event.
Want to look around first? Tap Try the live demo. It's a birthday party already in full swing.
That's Host Mode. Next up: creating your first event.
